clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner guides novice tauren called by the Earth Mother. He teaches their first rites of nature magic on the Red Cloud Mesa.

Gart Mistrunner watches over Camp Narache as the Shu'halo rekindle their ancient druidic path. New tauren druids are sent to him when they take their first steps on the Red Cloud Mesa, often with a note commending them to his care. Gart teaches them to commune with the natural world. They draw on nature's restorative power and Mu'sha's lunar radiance to heal allies and strike down threats to the land.
